description: Opens a card where the user picks a logbook export from ForeFlight, Garmin Pilot or LogTen. The card reads the file on the user’s device, uploads nothing, and shows the flight hours and CO₂ by aircraft type. The user can then share those totals with this conversation. Use it when someone wants the CO₂ of their flying from their logbook.
name: import_logbook

methodUrl.description: How the CO₂ per hour is worked out

title: Import a pilot logbook
